Fixture Research Experience for High School Students (FRE-HS)

FRE-HS is an eight-week paid summer research internship for local high school students interested in biology and marine science. Students are matched with a working lab and complete an independent research project under the mentorship of a graduate student or postdoc.

Eligibility

Open to current 10th, 11th, and 12th grade students who are residents of San Diego County. Applicants must have completed at least one year of high school biology or chemistry. No prior research experience is required.

Program Dates

The 2027 program runs June 21 through August 13, 2027.

Stipend

Selected students receive a $2,500 stipend for the summer.

How to Apply

Applications open on December 1, 2026 and are due by February 15, 2027. Late applications are not accepted. Decisions are announced by April 1, 2027.
